content: Hello! how can I help today?
I launched an LLC this year. Can I deduct setup expenses?
Yes. You may deduct up to **$5,000** of **start-up costs** under **IRC §195** and amortize the rest over 180 months. This includes legal, consulting, and market analysis costs.

1. Total your eligible startup costs
2. Deduct up to $5,000 immediately (phased out after $50,000 in costs)
3. Amortize the remainder using **Form 4562**, Part VI
4. Include the amortization schedule in your tax records
Can I deduct expenses before I had income?
Yes—costs incurred **before the business opens** still qualify under §195. Deduction begins once the business is considered ‘active’.
No separate election—filing **Form 4562** is deemed an election. Just be sure your records reflect business launch date and expense classification.
